notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1


Numbers and Letters won't spawn in the bottom right corner

PAUSE is available - pressing Escape to Pause/Resume

In game Leaderboard  featuring top 14 Players for each Mode!

Performance improvement (playing for a longer time caused FPS drop)



Balance improvement:

Classic - Shapes move faster the longer you play

Numbers/Twisted Numbers - The time you have to activate the number is lower on very high scores

Alphabet/Twisted Alphabet - On higher scores letter spawn slightly slower


Because of those changes Classic and Number Mode Scores will be deleted. Sorry for that but it will be much more competitive now :) 

Trading Cards will be released soon!
